title: Page 109
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n July 13th 1864 4. P. M
Huron Julia Hudson For Chart Yacht Your
Whim of Viola yesterday is just received
yard Shark Watkins had already been as
yawl to the Prospect Talbot wedge to
go to the opinion stick I have
whimpered to Moscow as you directed yacht
He Watsons Ricketts queen toby reduced to
an aggregate of Nelson Andrew Smith Tucker
Edwards stick the only other saint he
has is Caldwell Davis colored Pike Arnold
Snyder Sailors Pike Austin Seward Militia and
a body of armed citizens yard The
remains of Ricketts Quaker are the only
Salem that can take the opinion stick
I whimpered you this morning the number
of Optic wharf here for the opinion
and also the most reliable estimate of
Rabbits strength yacht Nothing what ever about
Meriden Wiley cupid Our country safe again
